items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: And uh, of course that's Teo that's clarinet you're hearing there. We had nine men in the orchestra

ctx.x: Who did he arrange it on?

He did his stuff. Pete wrote it and arranged it. And of course when it was in New York I think it was published by Williams. I'm not positive, I don't know, I'm sure it was. I know West Indies Blues was published by Clarence, you know. And uh, we did that number on uh, I think, OK recording. If I'm not mistaken. Because we did record for OK, the Brumvicks and Victor people. Three companies. Three companies. And uh, of course that's Teo that's clarinet you're hearing there. We had nine men in the orchestra and uh,…
I heard you take a break back there on the banjo.
